scope: Exploratory mechanism diagnostic on reused development audit; no independent confirmation

quality.duplicate_sha_policy: remove all colliding selected files, and exclude any hash matching prior pilot; no replacements

flow.mask: per-pixel intersection of correct, wrong_integer, fractional validity; identical for every arm

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum calibration clean BCE; tie earliest

limitations: Single real source and two legacy fake generators; not cross-generator generalization.
Historical audit data already used for metadata diagnostics; no confirmatory test claims.
Nominal-CFR index plan with recorded decoded timestamps; comprehensive source timing still not certified.
Resizing/cropping removes metadata fields but cannot guarantee removal of resampling or codec fingerprints.
Corruptions are applied after spatial preprocessing; they do not simulate full platform transmission.
Small random-initialized CNN/GRU baselines; not reproductions of MAST or other published detectors.
Same 595 videos and split as prior order gate; audit reused explicitly for mechanism exploration.
No independent real source, unseen generator, semantic deduplication or true transmission validation.
All five arms use the same 49,601 parameter bag network; gain is a hypothesis, not a novel-method claim.
Bootstrap is video-level stratified; known groups checked unique, unknown ancestry remains unresolved.

selection.roles: 60/20/20 within real and each fake source

decision_gate.pass: Both primary deltas >= .02, both lower95 > 0, >=2 positive seeds each; independent-source replication still required
decision_gate.failure: Do not advance motion-mechanism claim or scale memory; preserve negative results

controls.correct: Farneback current-to-previous sampling estimate quantized to 1/32 pixel OpenCV interpolation table resolution; not ground-truth optical flow
controls.wrong_integer: floor(flow) rolled spatially by half image on both axes + original per-pixel fractional(flow)
controls.fractional: flow-floor(flow); one bilinear remap with same per-pixel fractional interpolation weights as correct, no integer motion
controls.raw: unwarped previous frame, common mask; anchor only, not interpolation-matched
controls.compensation_gain: abs(fractional residual)-abs(correct residual), channelwise signed local error reduction, common mask
controls.mask_probe: 8 features: temporal coverage mean/std/min/max and mean invalid fraction in four quadrants; LR C=1
controls.statistics_probe: per-arm mean absolute, std of per-time mean absolute, RMS, 95th percentile; LR C=1
controls.limitations: Wrong control changes integer displacement field spatial structure; equal weights do not equal sampled texture; fractional control retains subpixel motion; masks can still encode source. No exact-motion or causal claim.
